study: Schmidt et al. 2020 (New Teacher Center i3 induction scale-up, SRI International final report)
delivery_evidence: TPD = NTC induction model: instructionally focused one-on-one coaching/mentoring of beginning teachers (mentors met one-on-one with mentees, classroom observations). Virtual/video coaching tools were available 'at their discretion' but 'uptake...was low...mentors reported that they did not adopt video sharing as a regular practice, preferring in-person interactions whenever possible' (p.~18-19; abstract). As implemented, mentoring was predominantly face-to-face.
test_alignment_evidence: Included math and ELA effect sizes are state standardized assessments (vary by district, standardized to district mean/SD), broad independent tests not tailored to the induction model (Exhibit 22, p.35; p.34 measures).
curriculum_evidence: Intervention is a teacher-induction/mentoring model to improve new teachers' instructional practice; no new student curriculum or instructional-materials package is adopted (abstract / NTC induction logic model, Exhibit 1; the 'tools' are coaching tools and an online mentoring platform for mentors, not a student curriculum).
outcome_timing_evidence: Included effect sizes are the one-year impact on students' state-test scores at the end of teachers' second induction year (2017-18 Cohort 1, 2018-19 Cohort 2) - end of the intervention (Exhibit 22, p.35; p.34 'one-year impact... in their second year of teaching').
